project.notes.title: How to run the tests
project.notes.body: Run cargo test --all from the project folder; the integration tests need the sample database in tests/data.
project.notes2.title: Do not touch
project.notes2.body: The files in migrations/ are applied in production: add a new migration instead of editing an old one.
project.recipe.title: Release notes
project.recipe.body: List the merged changes grouped by Added, Changed and Fixed, one line each.
claude.title: ISO week of the invoice date
claude.q: The invoice date 2027-01-01 shows week 1 of 2027, but it is week 53 of 2026. Fix src/dates.rs.
claude.a:
Fixed. `iso_week` now takes the year from the Thursday of the week, so 2027-01-01 falls in **week 53 of 2026**.

- `src/dates.rs`: new `week_year` helper used by `iso_week`
- `tests/dates.rs`: three cases around the new year
codex.title: Pagination for the invoice list
codex.q: Add pagination to GET /invoices with page and per_page, 50 per page by default.
codex.a:
Done. `GET /invoices` reads `page` (from 1) and `per_page` (1 to 200, default 50) and returns `total` with the items.

- `src/api/invoices.rs`: query parameters and the `LIMIT`/`OFFSET`
- `tests/api.rs`: first, middle and empty pages
copilot.title: Tests for the tax calculator
copilot.q: Write unit tests for src/tax.rs covering the reduced rate and rounding.
copilot.a: Added 6 tests in `tests/tax.rs`: standard and reduced rates, zero amount, and rounding half up at the cent. All pass with `cargo test tax`.
cursor.title: PDF renderer cleanup
cursor.q: Split render_invoice in src/pdf.rs into header, lines and totals, without changing the output.
cursor.a: `render_invoice` now calls `render_header`, `render_lines` and `render_totals`. The PDF of the sample invoice is byte-for-byte the same as before.
kilo.title: Retry policy of the queue worker
kilo.q: How does the queue worker retry a failed job?
kilo.a: It retries up to **5 times** with exponential backoff (2 s, 4 s, 8 s…) and jitter, in `worker/retry.py`. After the fifth failure the job goes to the `dead` queue with the last error.
openrouter.title: Error messages of the API
openrouter.q: Review the error messages the API returns and point out the ones that leak internal details.
openrouter.a:
Two leak internals:

1. `500` on `/invoices/{id}/pdf` returns the file path of the template.
2. `422` on `/customers` repeats the SQL constraint name.

The others only say what the client can fix.
litellm.title: What changed in billing
litellm.q: Summarize what changed in the billing module this week.
litellm.a: Three changes: the tax rate is now read per customer, credit notes got their own number sequence, and invoices paid in full close automatically.
ollama.title: What util.py does
ollama.a: It has small helpers shared by the scripts: `slugify`, `money` (formats an amount with the currency) and `chunks` (splits a list into batches).
lmstudio.title: Explain the cache layer
lmstudio.q: Explain how the cache in src/cache.rs decides what to evict.
lmstudio.a: It is an LRU with a size limit: each read moves the entry to the front, and when the total passes `max_bytes` it drops entries from the back until it fits.
gemini.title: Rounding of converted amounts
gemini.q: Round the converted amounts in src/fx.rs to the minor unit of each currency (JPY has none).
gemini.a:
Done. `convert` now rounds with the `minor_units` of each currency: JPY amounts have no decimals and BHD amounts keep three.

- `src/fx.rs`: new `minor_units` table
- `tests/fx.rs`: cases for JPY, EUR and BHD
deepseek.title: Slow overdue query
deepseek.q: Why is the query in list_overdue slow on large accounts?
deepseek.a: It filters by `status` and `due_date`, but the only index is on `customer_id`, so it reads every invoice of the account. An index on `(customer_id, status, due_date)` lets it read only the overdue ones.
perplexity.title: PDF/A for archived invoices
perplexity.q: Which PDF/A level should archived invoices use?
perplexity.a: **PDF/A-3** if the invoice carries its XML inside (as in ZUGFeRD and Factur-X); otherwise **PDF/A-2b** is enough for long-term archiving. Both embed the fonts and forbid outside content.
manus.title: What the PDF library 1.0 changes
manus.q: List what changed in the PDF library from 0.9 to 1.0 that affects this project.
manus.a:
Two changes affect `src/pdf.rs`:

1. `Document::save` now returns a `Result`.
2. The default page size is A4 instead of Letter.

The rest (new font API, faster images) needs no change.
metaai.title: VAT number check
metaai.q: Check the format of the customer's VAT number in src/customers.rs before saving.
metaai.a:
Done. `save_customer` now checks the VAT number against the pattern of its country and returns `422` with the field name when it doesn't match.

- `src/customers.rs`: `valid_vat`
- `tests/customers.rs`: valid and invalid numbers for DE, FR and PT
kimi.title: Webhook signature
kimi.q: Check the signature of incoming payment webhooks in src/webhooks.rs.
kimi.a:
Done. The handler computes the HMAC-SHA256 of the body with the webhook secret and compares it in constant time; a missing or wrong signature returns `401`.

- `src/webhooks.rs`: `verify_signature`
- `tests/webhooks.rs`: valid, changed and missing signature
opencode.title: Rename customer_ref
opencode.q: Rename the field customer_ref to customer_code across the project.
opencode.a: Renamed in 7 files, including the API schema and the tests. The database change is a new migration, `0042_rename_customer_ref.sql`, instead of an edit to an old one, as the project notes ask.
aider.title: Late payment fee
aider.q: Add a 2% late fee to invoices paid more than 30 days after the due date.
aider.a:
Done, without a commit: `late_fee` in `src/billing.rs` adds 2% of the total when the payment comes more than 30 days late, and the invoice shows it as its own line.

Review the changes with `git diff`.
openhands.title: Test failing only in CI
openhands.q: test_monthly_total fails in CI but passes on my machine. Find out why and fix it.
openhands.a:
The test used the time zone of the machine: in CI (UTC), the last invoice of the month fell into the next month. It now builds its dates in UTC.

- `tests/report.rs`: fixed dates in UTC
devin.title: Health check endpoint
devin.q: Add a /health endpoint that checks the database connection.
devin.a:
Done. `GET /health` runs `SELECT 1` with a 2-second timeout and returns `200` with `{"db":"ok"}`, or `503` with the error.

- `src/api/health.rs` (new)
- `src/api/mod.rs`: route
- `tests/api.rs`: both answers
review.title: Discount codes at checkout
review.q: Apply discount codes at checkout: one code per order, percentage or fixed amount.
review.a:
Discount codes work at checkout. `apply_discount` validates the code, accepts one per order and never takes the total below zero.

- `src/checkout.rs`
- `src/discounts.rs` (new)
- `tests/checkout.rs`
review.r:
**Second opinion** — I read the diff without changing anything:

1. `apply_discount` compares the expiry date in local time; use UTC like the rest of `src/checkout.rs`.
2. A fixed discount in another currency is not converted.
plan.title: Multi-currency invoices
plan.q: Support invoices in several currencies, with the exchange rate of the invoice date.
split.title: Export reports
split.q: Add CSV and PDF export to the monthly report and a download button on the dashboard.
recall.title: Due date reminders
recall.q: How are the due date reminders scheduled?
recall.a: A daily job in `jobs/reminders.rs` looks for invoices due in 3 days and today, and sends one e-mail for each; it skips invoices already paid.
skill.title: Release notes for 2.4
skill.q: Write the release notes for version 2.4 from the merged pull requests.
skill.a:
## 2.4.0

### Added
- Discount codes at checkout
- CSV export of the monthly report

### Fixed
- ISO week of invoices dated on New Year's Day
rea.title: How the desktop app exports CSV
rea.q: How does the CSV export of the desktop app in /Applications/Ledger.app work? I want the same in our project.
rea.a:
REA traced the **Export CSV** menu item to `-[ExportController exportCSV:]` (0x10002f3a0), which builds rows with `LedgerRow.csvLine` and writes them with `NSFileHandle`.

- Separator `;` and dates in ISO 8601 (strings at 0x1000a41c0)
- Amounts with two decimals, without the currency sign

Not observed: how it escapes quotes. Next step: write `export_csv` in `src/export.rs` with the same columns.
live.title: Rename the customer field
find.title: Late fee rules
find.q: When do we charge a late fee on an invoice?
find.a: A late fee is charged when the invoice is 10 days past due: 2% of the invoice total, once. Invoices with an open dispute are skipped, and the fee shows as a new line on the next invoice.
find.a2: No: the late fee line uses tax rate zero, so the invoice total grows only by the fee itself.
